about.heading: Why BuyMeATee exists
about.quote: BuyMeATee was created from the belief that golf audiences want a more meaningful way to support the players and creators they follow. A coffee is quickly forgotten; a tee, a round, a tournament entry or a journey creates a story.
about.paragraphGap: Golf has a funding gap hiding in plain sight. The creators filming course reviews, the amateurs grinding through qualifying seasons, the coaches sharing what they know, the juniors coming through — they all carry real costs: green fees, entries, travel, equipment, production. Meanwhile, the audiences who love watching those journeys have no golf-native way to help beyond a generic tip.
about.paragraphClose: BuyMeATee closes that gap with support that speaks golf. Instead of a coffee, you buy a tee. Instead of a vague donation, you back a specific goal — and then you follow it: the progress, the setbacks, the milestone when it finally lands. Support becomes participation.
about.paragraphJoin: We're at the start of our own journey, building BuyMeATee in the open with the creators and supporters who <link>sign up</link>. If that sounds like a round you'd want in on, we'd love to have you.

why.heading: Golf journeys are better shared
why.intro: Green fees, entries, travel and gear add up fast — and the golfers creating the content and chasing the goals usually carry it all themselves. BuyMeATee spreads that weight across the community that wants to see them succeed.

forCreators.heading: Turn followers into part of the journey.
forCreators.intro: You create the content, play the tournaments and put in the practice. BuyMeATee gives the people who follow you a meaningful, golf-native way to back what you're working towards.

who.heading: Made for emerging golfers, not just famous ones
who.intro: If you have a journey worth following, you belong here — whatever the size of your audience.
who.juniorsNote: Junior golfers are welcome through a parent or guardian. Accounts involving anyone under 18 will always require an appropriate parent or guardian — minors will never enter financial agreements independently on BuyMeATee.

goals.heading: Specific goals beat vague tips
goals.intro: Supporters respond to something real: a trip they can follow, a season they can back, a milestone they can celebrate with you. Goals give your community a reason to take part — and show them exactly what they helped make possible.

forSupporters.intro: A coffee is quickly forgotten. A tee, a round or a tournament entry becomes part of a story — one you helped write.

meaning.heading: Small gestures, real momentum
meaning.intro: Buying a tee is golf's version of saying keep going. It's a contribution towards something specific — a green fee, a tournament entry, the travel to get there — sized so anyone can take part.
meaning.body: Every contribution sits against a visible goal with visible progress, so you always know what you're helping to make happen — and creators always know who to thank.

how.heading: From follower to part of the story

discover.title: Discover golfers
discover.body: Find creators through their own channels first — every creator shares their BuyMeATee link with their audience. Creator discovery inside the platform is planned for later.

chooseGoal.title: Choose a goal
chooseGoal.body: Each creator shares specific goals — a trip, a season, an entry, a series. Pick the one that resonates and see exactly what your support goes towards.

buyTee.title: Buy them a tee
buyTee.body: Choose a contribution that feels right: one tee, three tees, nine holes, a full round, a green fee or your own amount. Small support, made tangible.

followProgress.title: Follow the progress
followProgress.body: Creators will post updates and milestones so you can see the goal getting closer — and know the part you played when it lands. (Planned for launch.)

collect.title: Collect the journey
collect.body: Badges and collections marking the goals you've backed are on the roadmap — a record of the journeys you've been part of. (Planned for after launch.)

boundary.heading: Support, plainly defined
boundary.body: Supporting a golfer on BuyMeATee is exactly that — support. It is not an investment, it does not buy ownership or a share of anyone's career, and it does not guarantee content, results or rewards. What you get is honest: progress you can follow, milestones you helped reach, and a genuine connection to a journey you believe in.
boundary.payments: Payments are processed securely by Stripe, and every contribution goes to the creator's connected account. See <link>the FAQ</link> for how payments and fees work.
